title: The Audit Log records each build, wherever it was started
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it: open a work order (Work Orders > New, pick a customer and unit), start an inspection from a template with a checkbox field, mark one field Not OK and one Monitor, then complete and sign it.
  3. Complete builds started from the completed-inspection screen (S3), the report note (S4) and the asset Inspections tab (S6). Have a user with "View History Logs" and one without.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's Audit Log and confirm an entry reading 'Built from inspection'.
2. Confirm the entry names the inspection, links to it, and names the work order the inspection was run on.
3. Confirm both records are written whether the build started from S3, S4 or S6.
4. As a user without 'View History Logs', confirm the Audit Log is not shown but the entry is still recorded.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • An entry reading "Built from inspection" is added to that work order's Audit Log.
  • The Audit Log entry names the inspection, links to it, and names the work order the inspection was run on.
  • Both records are written however the build was started, from S3, S4 or S6.
  • Without 'View History Logs', the Audit Log is not shown to the user, but the entry is still recorded.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9105 (S7 — Record where the lines came from); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S7; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “An entry reading "Built from inspection" will be added to that work order's Audit Log”
  • S7-R5: “The Audit Log entry will name the inspection, link to it, and name the work order the inspection was run on”
  • S7-R6: “Both records will be written however the build was started, from S3, S4 or S6”
  • S7-N2: “If the user does not have 'View History Logs' enabled, the Audit Log is not shown to them. The entry is still recorded”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
